sourceEvidence.engineDivergence: Three engine siblings, and they diverge more than any other family in this cohort. PARTS: modern has 9 (adds header-row and extra); rustic has 7 (no header-row, no extra); classic renders the AntD .ant-collapse tree and stamps no data-part. STATES: modern distinguishes idle/hover/active(pressed)/focus-visible/disabled/expanded; rustic distinguishes expanded and disabled only ([data-part='arrow'][data-expanded], rustic/index.tsx:168); classic exposes :hover and .ant-collapse-item-active only. READS: the three engines read three disjoint naming schemes (see namingSchemeConflict) -- modern reads the {slot}-{variant}-{state} matrix, rustic reads the short palette, classic reads a fourteen-name palette with zero fallbacks, and runtime/bridges/collapse.css reads a fourth bridge scheme that no engine declares.

variableReadCensus.namingSchemeConflict: THREE competing --ds-collapse-* naming schemes coexist in live source and do NOT resolve to one another: (1) the matrix scheme --ds-collapse-{slot}-{variant}-{state}-{property} read by the modern skin and declared only by presentation/components/collapse.css (convention documented at that file:6); (2) a short palette --ds-collapse-{bg,border,header-bg,header-bg-hover,header-color,content-bg,content-color,radius,border-color,header-padding,content-padding,icon-size,icon-color,...} read by the rustic skin and by classic/theme.css:2390-2457 and emitted by the tenant artifacts; (3) a bridge scheme --ds-collapse-root-{bg,border-color,border-width,border-radius,shadow} / --ds-collapse-header-padding-{y,x} / --ds-collapse-content-padding-{y,x} / --ds-collapse-icon-size read only by runtime/bridges/collapse.css. A tenant setting one scheme does not move the other two.

fallbackIsTheContract.sourceClaim: The docblock states the matrix channels are declared ONLY by presentation/components/collapse.css, which ships in styles.css but NOT in base.css, so 'the production modern bundles (dist/<vertical>.css) declare zero matrix channels (verified: dist/bithire.css) ... in the modern runtime they are UNDECLARED hooks whose fallback IS their contract.'
